title.zh: U.S. September CPI comes in hot, sending bitcoin sharply lower
title.en: U.S. September CPI comes in hot, sending bitcoin sharply lower

current_state.zh: U.S. September CPI came in hotter than expected — 3.7% year-over-year headline and 2.6% core — sending Treasury yields sharply higher and bitcoin sharply lower as traders priced in the possibility of further Federal Reserve rate hikes.
